init.darwin: npm install -g @baomihuatop/popcorn-cli@0.3.0 && popcorn-cli config set-url https://baomihua.top
init.linux: npm install -g @baomihuatop/popcorn-cli@0.3.0 && popcorn-cli config set-url https://baomihua.top
init.win32: npm install -g @baomihuatop/popcorn-cli@0.3.0 && popcorn-cli.cmd config set-url https://baomihua.top

auth.darwin: popcorn-cli config set-url https://baomihua.top && popcorn-cli auth login --no-browser --adapter workbuddy
auth.linux: popcorn-cli config set-url https://baomihua.top && popcorn-cli auth login --no-browser --adapter workbuddy
auth.win32: popcorn-cli.cmd config set-url https://baomihua.top && popcorn-cli.cmd auth login --no-browser --adapter workbuddy

status.darwin: popcorn-cli config show | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{try{if(JSON.parse(s).base_url!=='https://baomihua.top'){console.error('Connect to https://baomihua.top');process.exitCode=3}}catch{process.exitCode=1}})" && popcorn-cli auth status --format workbuddy
status.linux: popcorn-cli config show | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{try{if(JSON.parse(s).base_url!=='https://baomihua.top'){console.error('Connect to https://baomihua.top');process.exitCode=3}}catch{process.exitCode=1}})" && popcorn-cli auth status --format workbuddy
status.win32: popcorn-cli.cmd config show | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{try{if(JSON.parse(s).base_url!=='https://baomihua.top'){console.error('Connect to https://baomihua.top');process.exitCode=3}}catch{process.exitCode=1}})" && popcorn-cli.cmd auth status --format workbuddy
